name: Box
description: Connect your own Box enterprise via a Custom App (Client Credentials Grant) to manage Folders, Files, Versions, Search, Collaborations, Shared Links, Comments, Tasks, Metadata Templates, and Webhooks.

tools.name: connect_box
tools.description: Connect your own Box enterprise via a Custom App (Client Credentials Grant): Client ID, Client Secret, and Enterprise ID.

label.description: Friendly enterprise label, e.g. 'Acme Corp Box'.
label.title: Label

client_id.description: Box Custom App Client ID, from Developer Console > Configuration.
client_id.title: Client Id

client_secret.description: Box Custom App Client Secret, from Developer Console > Configuration.
client_secret.title: Client Secret

enterprise_id.description: Box Enterprise ID, from Developer Console or Admin Console.
enterprise_id.title: Enterprise Id

default_as_user_id.description: Optional: Box user ID to impersonate by default (requires admin-authorized as-user scope). Leave blank to act as the enterprise Service Account.
default_as_user_id.title: Default As User Id

tools.name: disconnect_box
tools.description: Disconnect a Box enterprise: deletes the saved Custom App credentials. Nothing in Box itself is changed.

connection_id.description: Saved Box enterprise connection ID to remove from Imperal.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected Box enterprises.

tools.name: list_collaborations
tools.description: List collaborators (permissions) on a folder or file.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_collaboration
tools.description: Grant a user or group access (a role: viewer, editor, co-owner, etc.) to a folder or file.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

item_id.description: Box folder or file ID to grant access to.
item_id.title: Item Id

grantee_login.description: Email address of the person to invite, e.g. 'jane@example.com'. Provide either grantee_login or grantee_id.
grantee_login.title: Grantee Login

grantee_id.description: Box user or group ID to invite. Provide either grantee_login or grantee_id.
grantee_id.title: Grantee Id

tools.name: update_collaboration
tools.description: Change an existing collaborator's role.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: remove_collaboration
tools.description: Revoke a collaborator's access to a folder or file.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

collaboration_id.description: Collaboration ID to revoke, from list_collaborations.
collaboration_id.title: Collaboration Id

tools.name: create_shared_link
tools.description: Create or update a shared link on a file or folder.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

item_id.description: Box folder or file ID to create a shared link on.
item_id.title: Item Id

access.description: Shared link access level: 'open' (anyone with the link), 'company' (enterprise only), or 'collaborators' (invited people only).
access.title: Access

can_download.description: Whether people with the link can download the file.
can_download.title: Can Download

tools.name: get_shared_link
tools.description: Read a file or folder's current shared link, if any.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: clear_shared_link
tools.description: Remove the shared link from a file or folder.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List comments on a file.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

file_id.description: Box file ID, from list_folder_items or search_files.
file_id.title: File Id

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a file.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

file_id.description: Box file ID, from list_folder_items or search_files.
file_id.title: File Id

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Permanently delete a comment.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

comment_id.description: Comment ID to delete, from list_comments.
comment_id.title: Comment Id

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a review/approval task on a file.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

file_id.description: Box file ID, from list_folder_items or search_files.
file_id.title: File Id

tools.name: assign_task
tools.description: Assign a Box task to a user by login (email) or user id.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

task_id.description: Task ID to assign, from create_task or list_tasks.
task_id.title: Task Id

assignee_login.description: Email address of the assignee. Provide either assignee_login or assignee_id.
assignee_login.title: Assignee Login

assignee_id.description: Box user ID of the assignee. Provide either assignee_login or assignee_id.
assignee_id.title: Assignee Id

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks on a file.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

file_id.description: Box file ID, from list_folder_items or search_files.
file_id.title: File Id

tools.description: Permanently delete a task.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

task_id.description: Task ID to delete, from list_tasks.
task_id.title: Task Id

tools.name: list_folder_items
tools.description: List files and subfolders inside a Box folder.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

folder_id.description: Box folder ID. Use '0' for the root folder.
folder_id.title: Folder Id

tools.name: get_file
tools.description: Read one Box file's metadata in full.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

file_id.description: Box file ID, from list_folder_items or search_files.
file_id.title: File Id

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

file_id.description: Box file ID, from list_folder_items or search_files.
file_id.title: File Id

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload a new file (base64-encoded content) into a folder.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

folder_id.description: Folder ID to upload into. Use '0' for root.
folder_id.title: Folder Id

name.description: File name to save as, e.g. 'contract.pdf'.

tools.name: update_file
tools.description: Rename a file and/or move it to a different folder.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

file_id.description: Box file ID, from list_folder_items or search_files.
file_id.title: File Id

name.description: New file name. Leave blank to keep the current name.
name.title: Name

new_parent_folder_id.description: Destination parent folder ID to move into. Leave blank to keep in place.

tools.name: copy_file
tools.description: Copy a file into a (possibly different) folder.

target_folder_id.description: Destination folder ID to copy into.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

file_id.description: Box file ID, from list_folder_items or search_files.
file_id.title: File Id

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search files and folders across the connected Box enterprise by free-text query.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_folder
tools.description: Read one Box folder's metadata in full, including item count and owner.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

folder_id.description: Box folder ID. Use '0' for the root folder.
folder_id.title: Folder Id

connection_id.title: Connection Id

parent_folder_id.description: Parent folder ID to create the new folder inside. Use '0' for root.
parent_folder_id.title: Parent Folder Id

tools.name: rename_or_move_folder
tools.description: Rename a folder and/or move it to a different parent folder.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

folder_id.description: Box folder ID. Use '0' for the root folder.
folder_id.title: Folder Id

name.description: New folder name. Leave blank to keep the current name.

new_parent_folder_id.description: Destination parent folder ID to move into. Leave blank to keep in place.

folder_id.description: Box folder ID. Use '0' for the root folder.
folder_id.title: Folder Id

connection_id.title: Connection Id

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

file_id.description: Box file ID, from list_folder_items or search_files.
file_id.title: File Id

tools.description: Create or update a metadata instance of a given template on a file, from a JSON object of field values.

file_id.description: Box file ID, from list_folder_items or search_files.
file_id.title: File Id

fields_json.description: JSON object of field-name to value pairs matching the template's schema, e.g. '{"status": "Approved"}'.
fields_json.title: Fields Json

tools.name: delete_metadata
tools.description: Remove a metadata instance of a given template from a file.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

file_id.description: Box file ID, from list_folder_items or search_files.
file_id.title: File Id

tools.description: List the saved versions of a file.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

file_id.description: Box file ID, from list_folder_items or search_files.
file_id.title: File Id

tools.name: promote_file_version
tools.description: Promote a previous file version to be the current version (Box keeps history rather than truly reverting).

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Subscribe to change events on a file or folder -- Box will POST to your HTTPS endpoint when those events occur.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

target_id.description: Folder or file ID to watch for changes.
target_id.title: Target Id

address.description: HTTPS URL Box should POST event notifications to.
address.title: Address

triggers.description: Event types to subscribe to, e.g. ['FILE.UPLOADED', 'FILE.TRASHED', 'FOLDER.CREATED'].
triggers.title: Triggers

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List active change-event webhooks configured on the connected enterprise.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Permanently delete a webhook subscription. Cannot be undone.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: audit_content_health
tools.description: Scan a folder for content-health issues: shared links on files that have not been modified recently, empty (0-byte) files, and webhooks with no event triggers configured.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Box enterprise connection ID. Omit to use the first connected enterprise.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

folder_id.description: Folder ID to audit. Use '0' for root.
folder_id.title: Folder Id

stale_link_days.description: Flag shared links older than this many days as potentially stale.
stale_link_days.title: Stale Link Days

secrets.name: box_connections
secrets.description: JSON list of connected Box enterprises and encrypted Custom App (Client Credentials Grant) credentials. Managed only through connect_box and disconnect_box.
